summary: The single medium finding is confirmed, with the scope made precise. The accepted Zigzag link map records the QuiverRepresentations Layer 3 → Zigzag Layer 3 prerequisite only in alreadyRecorded, which merge_links never reads. The only links entry for the pair is in the QuiverRepresentations link map, which is status 'partial', has no review block and has no data/links counterpart. The production assembler gives 2,840 stages and 8,007 edges; all 13 focal links are edges and requires entries, but the Quiver 3 → Zigzag 3 pair is neither, and there is no forward or reverse path between its endpoints. Merging exactly this one link gives 8,008 edges, a second merge also gives 8,008, and the union of the assembled graph, all requires entries and every research link map's links (8,118 edges) is acyclic. The mathematics holds: Zigzag 3 builds the heads, radical layers and q = 1 composition-factor Cartan matrix of Z e_i, which is Quiver 3's primitive-idempotent/projective-cover/Cartan infrastructure applied to a finite-dimensional split basic algebra. Scope corrections: (1) the Quiver packet's Zigzag-side quotation has its continuation indentation stripped ('\nlayers' for the raw '\n  layers'); the fixer must use the raw text, even though check_links tolerates both; (2) the red team's 'no indirect path' holds today, but the confirmed GEF red-team fix will add Quiver 3 → GEF 4, giving an indirect Quiver 3 → GEF 4 → Zigzag 3 path; the direct edge is still needed, since Zigzag 3 uses covers, heads and primitive idempotents directly and the GEF 4 edge carries only the K₀/Cartan-map frame.

findings.reason:
Confirmed, with the scope made precise. Evidence checked at main d870bd36. (a) The accepted Zigzag map (review accepted by codex-7e92bd) carries Quiver 3 → Zigzag 3 only as alreadyRecorded[0], 'Present in the sibling packet; not duplicated here'; its 13 links are all incoming and the pair is not among them. The promoted data/links copy is byte-identical (SHA-256 6c8de93a…). (b) The QuiverRepresentations map has status 'partial', no review block and no data/links file (its link work was merged only as a partial checkpoint, PR #637). (c) Code path: build.assemble loads only data/links (build.py L69–75); merge_links rejects unreviewed packets and iterates packet['links'] only (decompositions.py L267ff), so alreadyRecorded never reaches the graph. (d) I ran the production assembler in memory, writing nothing: 2,840 stages, 8,007 edges. Both endpoints are atlas stages; all 13 focal links are edges and requires entries; Quiver 3 → Zigzag 3 is neither, and with requires included there is no forward or reverse path. (e) Mathematics. For a finite graph with no isolated vertices the zigzag algebra Z is finite-dimensional with Z/rad Z ≅ k^I, so it is split basic, the e_i are primitive, Z e_i is the projective cover of the simple S_i with head S_i, and [P_i : S_j] = dim e_j Z e_i. That is exactly Quiver 3's primitive-idempotent/projective-cover/composition-Cartan infrastructure (README L288–294), which Zigzag 3 consumes when it builds the head and radical layers of Z e_i and identifies the q = 1 specialization with 'the ordinary composition-factor Cartan matrix' (L290–291). The Q1 → Z3 link (unbound module equivalence) and the G4 → Z3 link (K₀ and the Cartan map) do not supply covers or primitive idempotents. The symmetric zigzag Cartan matrix hides the [P_i:S_j] versus [P_j:S_i] transpose, so the convention must stay explicit. (f) The pinned library does not make the edge void: Tau Ceti f790474 has IsProjectiveCover, exists_isProjectiveCover_of_finiteDimensional and zigzagProjective_projective, but no algebra Cartan matrix or primitive-idempotent decomposition. The edge records a planning dependency and the fix should cite these declarations for reuse. (g) Quotations and checks. The Quiver-side quotation is a literal substring of the atlas stage description. The Zigzag-side quotation in the Quiver packet is NOT literal: it has '
layers' where the raw text has '
  layers'. A scratch copy of the Zigzag map with the link added (14 links) passes check_links.py with 0 errors and 0 warnings using either the stripped or the raw quote, so the checker will not catch this. Merging the one link into the assembled atlas gives 8,008 edges, a second merge also gives 8,008, requires is filled, and the cycle check passes. The union of the assembled edges, all requires entries, every research link map's links and the proposal (8,118 edges) is acyclic; it already contains the Quiver 3 → GEF 4 pair confirmed in the GEF red team, so the two fixes are jointly acyclic. Adversarial notes on the red team: its 'no indirect path' is true today, but the confirmed FIX-RT for GrothendieckEulerForms will add Quiver 3 → GEF 4, giving an indirect Quiver 3 → GEF 4 → Zigzag 3 path. The direct edge is still warranted, since Zigzag 3 uses covers, heads and primitive idempotents directly, and a transitive path does not fill Zigzag 3's requires. Its evidence text quotes only the first line of the Zigzag bullet; the fixer must quote the raw two-line form. Severity medium stands: a real prerequisite missing from the atlas, with no change to what Zigzag builds. Authorized scope for FIX-RT: (i) Append exactly one link to the links array of research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_ZigzagPreprojective.json: source tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/QuiverRepresentations#layer-3-the-structure-of-a-finite-dimensional-algebra, target tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ZigzagPreprojective#layer-3-projectives-graded-cartan-matrices-and-q-euler-forms, confidence 'inferred'. Evidence: the Quiver-side quotation as in the Quiver packet, and the Zigzag-side quotation with its raw indentation: 'Define the indecomposable graded left projective `P_i = Z e_i`, its simple head, socle, radical
  layers, grading shifts, and all homogeneous `Hom(P_i,P_j{d})` spaces.' (ii) Remove alreadyRecorded[0] and record it in provenance, or retag it to say the host is a partial, unreviewed research packet and the pair is now carried in links.
